prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1394; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn and was struck by another vehicle. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide a complete statement of the liability coverage limits under the policy issued to the insured driver, along with declarations pages and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm in writing the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

Your insured and your company are hereby placed on notice to preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, witness statements, recorded calls, repair estimates, and any physical components of the vehicles involved. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt response.
